Oliver Cromwell's head was buried three hundred years after the rest of him.
Cromwell ruled England after the king lost his head. He died in sixteen fifty-eight, with a royal funeral.
The monarchy came back. In sixteen sixty-one, they dug him up, hanged his body, and cut off his head.
Stuck on a spike above Westminster Hall, for more than twenty years.
It vanished. Then it went on tour: a private museum, a failed actor, a jeweller, a paid exhibition.
In nineteen sixty, his old college in Cambridge buried it. Exactly where is still a secret.
